items.title: AI accounting platform Kabilio raises €10m
items.snippet: Kabilio, a Barcelona-based AI platform for accounting firms and the small businesses they serve, has raised €10 million in a funding round led by Picus Capital and Visionaries.

items.title: Merge builds product and business tools with OpenAI technology
items.snippet: Merge uses GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT, and Codex to review product code and support marketing. Its teams also use AI to plan executive dinners and prepare sales updates.
